name: Sylvan Empathy
body:
The animal companion gains familiar-like abilities.

Prerequisites: Companion level 3rd, Wis 13

Benefit: Your intuition paired with your connection to your master has granted you improved communication abilities. You gain the familiar’s empathic link ability when you take this feat. Furthermore, you gain the abilities speak with master and speak with animals of its kind at 5th and 7th level respectively. You retain these speech abilities as long as you are within 30 feet of your master, and as long as you are within this range, you gain a +2 morale bonus to Intelligence.
